text: # GEO report: Millstone Bakery **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 100/100, Strong Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 23 ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. High = (23 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. This is a small static HTML site. I sampled 3 indexable pages plus the private members page. All read from code, and nothing is unknown. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first Nothing in the rules is failing. The most useful step is a small fix outside the rules. ### 1. Add the missing loaves image - **Why it matters:** the home page points at a file that isn't in the repo, so readers and crawlers may get a 404. - **Where:** `index.html:16` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 100 (unchanged) ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `robots.txt:1-8` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have access | Clear | `robots.txt:1-3`. Only GPTBot (training) is blocked, which matches your policy | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Clear | 3 of 3 routes. Only `members/index.html:9` is noindex, and it's not in the sitemap | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own origin | Clear | `index.html:8`, `breads.html:8`, `classes.html:8` | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Static HTML | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | None present | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt:8` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Clear | 3 of 3 routes | | GEO-016 | Links in server HTML | Clear | `` nav on every page | | GEO-017 | No snippet conflict | Clear | Only element-level `data-nosnippet` at `breads.html:16`, which is deliberate | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | I read all 4 pages. The image has alt text and every link has text | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info) | Not scored | Absent | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info) | Not scored | Not an app | ## Other problems found - `index.html:16`: ``. No `img/` folder exists in the repo. Add the file or fix the path. ## Worth considering - **Label the business in structured data:** `index.html:6`: `Millstone Bakery, sourdough in York`. Add Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, address and opening hours. It could help machines identify the business. - **Show address and hours as text:** `index.html:14`: `Sourdough baked in York every morning`. No address, hours or contact appear on any page. Add them to the home page or a visit section. - **List the loaves:** `breads.html:15`: `Over twenty loaves through the week`. Only two are named. List each loaf, with ingredients and the days it's baked. Each could have its own page. - **Give class details:** `classes.html:15`: `Book early, because places go quickly.` There is no price, date, duration or booking link. Add these as text. - **Explain pre-ordering:** `index.html:15`: `Pre-order for weekend collection.` There is no how-to or link. Add a page or section covering how to order. - **Add ``:** `sitemap.xml:3`. Entries have no dates. Add them if you have real change dates. - **Add social tags:** each page head sets no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image`. Add them so shared links look right. - **Link between pages:** `breads.html:15` and `classes.html:15` have no onward links, and breads doesn't link to classes. Add a few related links. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Server status codes and headers:** whether pages return 200 and whether an `X-Robots-Tag` header is set outside the repo. A live scan would confirm this. ## Assumptions - Your `geo.config.json` says AI search crawlers are allowed, and I took that as the goal. - The `.example` domain is a placeholder, and the live origin is the one in `geo.config.json`. - `/members/` is deliberately private. It's disallowed in `robots.txt` and set to noindex. Because crawlers can't fetch the page, they may never see the noindex tag. That's fine, since nothing links to it from the sitemap. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
